description: This line plot illustrates the Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the Number of tokens, comparing two scenarios labeled in the legend as “w/o material information”. The x-axis, labeled “Number of tokens”, spans from approximately 0.6 to 1.4, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, ranges from 48 to 58. The plot features two lines: the upper line is red with circular markers and a solid line, starting at approximately 55.2% at 0.6 tokens, peaking at 58% at 1.0 token, then declining to about 50.5% at 1.4 tokens. The lower line is purple with circular markers and a dashed line, beginning at about 52.2% at 0.6 tokens, remaining relatively stable around 52% until 1.4 tokens, where it drops sharply to 48% at 1.4 tokens. Both lines are accompanied by shaded regions representing uncertainty or variability around the mean scores.
